texts.title: 蜘蛛の糸
texts.author: 芥川竜之介
texts.summaryEn: The Buddha, strolling by the lotus pond in paradise, sees the robber Kandata in hell and remembers his one good deed: sparing a spider. He lowers a spider's thread to save him, but when Kandata tries to keep the other sinners off the thread, it snaps.

texts.title: 夢十夜　第一夜
texts.author: 夏目漱石
texts.titleEn: Ten Nights of Dreams: The First Night
texts.summaryEn: The narrator dreams that a woman tells him calmly she is about to die and asks him to bury her and wait a hundred years by her grave. He waits through countless sunrises and sunsets until a white lily blooms from the grave, and he realizes the hundred years have passed.

texts.title: 手袋を買いに
texts.author: 新美南吉
texts.summaryEn: A fox cub's paws get cold in the first snow, so his mother sends him into town at night to buy mittens, one paw changed into a human hand. At the shop he holds out the wrong paw, but the hatter sells him mittens anyway, and the cub goes home wondering whether humans are really so frightening.

texts.title: 金の輪
texts.author: 小川未明
texts.summaryEn: A sick boy, Taro, sees an unknown boy running by his house bowling two golden hoops that ring beautifully. He longs to be friends with him and dreams of running together toward the red evening sky, but soon afterwards Taro falls ill again and dies.

texts.title: 野ばら
texts.author: 小川未明
texts.summaryEn: An old soldier and a young soldier guard the border between two countries and become friends beside a wild rose. When war breaks out the young man leaves for the front; the old man later dreams of him passing by with his troops, and learns the young man's country has been defeated.

texts.title: 蜜柑
texts.author: 芥川竜之介
texts.summaryEn: A tired, gloomy narrator shares a train compartment with a coarse country girl who struggles to open the window. As the train passes a crossing she throws tangerines to her little brothers waiting to see her off, and the sight lifts his weariness for a moment.

texts.title: やまなし
texts.author: 宮沢賢治
texts.summaryEn: Two crab brothers watch life at the bottom of a mountain stream in two short scenes: in May a kingfisher snatches a fish, and in December a wild pear falls into the water, smells sweet, and their father tells them to wait until it ripens into wine.

texts.title: 月夜と眼鏡
texts.author: 小川未明
texts.titleEn: The Moonlit Night and the Spectacles
texts.summaryEn: On a quiet moonlit spring night an old woman sewing alone buys a pair of spectacles from a mysterious peddler. Later a girl knocks, saying she has hurt her finger, and through the spectacles the old woman sees she is really a butterfly from the flower garden.
